state.originalConfig:
[global]
   workgroup = WORKGROUP
   server string = Samba Server
   server role = standalone server
   passdb backend = tdbsam
   log file = /var/log/samba/log.%m
   max log size = 50
   dns proxy = no
   security = user
   map to guest = never
   veto files = /lost+found/

[share]
   path = /mnt/share
   browseable = yes
   writable = yes
   guest ok = no
   valid users = debian winuser pad2gate3
   force user = debian
   read only = no
   create mask = 0666
   directory mask = 0777
   force create mode = 0666
   force directory mode = 0777

[storage]
   path = /mnt/storage
   browseable = yes
   writable = yes
   guest ok = no
   valid users = debian
   force user = debian
   read only = no
   create mask = 0666
   directory mask = 0777
   force create mode = 0666
   force directory mode = 0777

[smb]
   path = /mnt/smb
   browseable = yes
   writable = yes
   guest ok = no
   valid users = debian winuser
   force user = debian
   read only = no
   create mask = 0666
   directory mask = 0777
   force create mode = 0666
   force directory mode = 0777
